decision.reason: The diff shows only that v2.0.0 dropped an error-return line from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go. That line said the --enable-environment-configs flag "will be removed in a future release". The excerpts for both versions [ev-2875a348b5d7] [ev-59d22c21eec4] contain only "/*", so they don't show whether v2.0.0 still declares the flag. Losing the error message alone doesn't prove the flag was removed: the check could have moved or the flag could now be ignored. To decide, I need the flag definitions in the v2.0.0 core.go, or a release note or upgrade guide saying the flag was removed.
